english.title: Channel tunnel - owner failed to comply with direction
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the owner of one or more Channel Tunnel trains within the tunnel system or elsewhere in the United Kingdom, failed, without reasonable excuse, to take such measures as specified in a direction given to you under article 16(2) of the Channel Tunnel (Security) Order 1994 in respect of all such trains owned by you or in respect of any trains specified in the direction
english.legislation: Contrary to article 16(7)(a) of the Channel Tunnel (Security) Order 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
owner of channel tunnel trains within the tunnel system/elsewhere in the UK
without reasonable excuse failed to take such measures given under article 16(2)

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See also associated offence wordings: H1390 and H1391.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
